title: AttnCompress: Dynamic Attention-Guided Trajectory Compression for Software Engineering Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The transition from human-centric assistance to Autonomous Software Engineering (ASE) agents has enabled the resolution of complex real-world SE tasks. However, the trial-and-error nature of these agents generates lengthy interaction trajectories, creating severe bottlenecks in terms of context window limits and cost. While context compression offers a potential remedy, prior approaches suffer from static pruning strategies and granularity mismatches, often failing to preserve the semantic dependencies and syntactic details crucial for SE tasks. translated_title: AttnCompress：面向软件工程智能体的动态注意力引导轨迹压缩
translated_abstract: 从以人为中心的辅助向自主软件工程（ASE）智能体的转变，使得解决复杂的真实世界软件工程任务成为可能。然而，这些智能体的试错特性会产生冗长的交互轨迹，在上下文窗口限制和成本方面造成严重瓶颈。虽然上下文压缩提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但先前的方法存在静态剪枝策略和粒度不匹配的问题，往往无法保留对软件工程任务至关重要的语义依赖关系和语法细节。为了在缩短上下文长度的同时严格保留关键任务证据，我们提出了AttnCompress，一种动态注意力引导的轨迹压缩框架。与现有方法不同，AttnCompress通过三个关键机制弥合了语义完整性与动态适应性之间的差距：(1) 通过困惑度（PPL）峰值进行结构感知分割，以保留语法结构……
tldr: 提出AttnCompress框架，通过动态注意力引导的轨迹压缩，在严格保留关键任务证据的同时有效缩短软件工程智能体的交互上下文长度，克服了传统静态剪枝方法无法兼顾语义依赖与语法细节的问题。
en_tdlr: AttnCompress is a dynamic attention-guided trajectory compression framework that bridges semantic integrity and dynamic adaptability, effectively shortening interaction contexts for software engineering agents while strictly preserving critical task evidence.
